The '''''Guardian 344''-class light cruiser''' was made by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] to succeed the [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class]]. It addressed the previous cruiser's lack of space for a boarding party. It is known that some 344s fell into pirate hands, an example would be ''[[The Last Thing]]'' owned by [[Dorok Zalaster]].<ref name="POTG,V3" />
